effort_banners.low: Effort: LOW. Be brief and mechanical. No exploration beyond the brief.
effort_banners.medium: Effort: MEDIUM. Think through edge cases before acting.
effort_banners.high: Effort: HIGH. Think hard. Enumerate hypotheses/alternatives before committing to one.
